a.lede: Anthropic’s S-1 shows more than half of its $100,000-plus customers now use both the Claude Platform and a first-party app, a cross-selling playbook reminiscent of Amazon that’s making enterprise customers stickier.
a.title: Anthropic’s IPO filing reveals its strategy for keeping enterprise customers hooked

b.lede: Anthropic’s S-1 splits its $8.9 billion H1 compute bill: most went to R&D, with less than a third estimated to serve Claude customers.
b.title: Anthropic’s IPO filing shows most of its compute goes to R&D, not serving customers
